title: A Matrix-free Augmented High Order Compact Solver for Variable-Coefficient Biharmonic Problems
summary: We propose an augmented high-order compact finite difference method for biharmonic equations with clamped boundary conditions and variable coefficients. Standard mixed-type formulations introduce an auxiliary variable, but its boundary values are unavailable, leaving the resulting discrete systems globally coupled and difficult to solve at large scales.
